policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: Moves a custom agent that 0.23.0's playbook migration fixed to Claude with no model (a playbook that saved only a permission) to Stave Auto, once per profile (marker setting playbookAgentsAutoRouted). Only an agent whose content hash still equals what 0.23.0 wrote from its saved playbook, and that has no version history, is changed.

Reads a Claude account profile that carries a gateway (stored up to 0.22.2) as an app-level API connection with the same id, label, key reference, models and Claude folder, and persists that conversion once at startup, so selections, queued turns, session cursors and CLI tabs naming the id keep working.

Projects were removed after 0.24.1. On host start, writes the memories (accepted decisions and notes, plus unaccepted candidates) of every project in the retained project_memories table to <user data>/exports/project-memory/<project id>.md, once per project: an existing file is never rewritten. The project tables themselves are left in place and are never read otherwise.

Missions were renamed agent runs after 0.24.1. A chat message saved before then marks an agent run's prompt with agentRunPrompt.missionId; the message schema reads that key as agentRunPrompt.agentRunId, so stored transcripts keep folding the compiled prompt under the assignment. The next save writes the new key.

Missions were renamed agent runs after 0.24.1. Before the first read, the agent run store renames the SQLite tables missions, mission_stages and mission_events to agent_runs, agent_run_stages and agent_run_events, their mission_id columns to agent_run_id and missions.playbook_json to workflow_json, drops the old-named indexes (the bootstrap recreates them as idx_agent_runs_*) and rewrites the event kinds mission-started and mission-ended to agent-run-started and agent-run-ended, in one savepoint. Tables that already carry the new name are left alone. The retired mission_proposals and mission_trigger_seen tables are no longer created and are never dropped.

Missions were renamed agent runs after 0.24.1. On every start the agent run store moves stored notifications of the kinds mission.sign_off_requested, mission.blocked, mission.stuck and mission.completed to agent_run.*, rewrites their dedupe keys (mission: and mission-reminder: become agent-run: and agent-run-reminder:) and their payload (source, missionId, missionIds), so an existing notification is still read and never raised twice. It matches nothing once converted.

Missions were renamed agent runs after 0.24.1. Settings rehydration reads the sign-off reminder interval saved as missionSignOffReminderMinutes into runSignOffReminderMinutes when the new key is absent, and drops the old key.

Missions were renamed agent runs after 0.24.1. A wake-up paused while a mission ran was stored with pause_reason mission-active; the wake-up store rewrites it to agent-run-active on every start, so the wake-up still parses and resumes when the agent run ends. It matches nothing once converted.

Stave Auto profile version 5 replaced the complexity ladder (Simple, Standard, Complex, Expert, Extreme). A starter profile saved before version 5 still carries the previous starter rule table, whose tiers no longer match the levels; profile validation gives it the current table once. Custom tables, stance, allowed models and signals are kept.

During the one-time account usage history import, maps the retired turn provider identity to the current Claude provider. Remove only the legacy CASE and filter entry at expiry; imports of current provider identities remain supported.
